Package org.bsc.langgraph4j

Class GraphDefinition.Nodes<State extends AgentState>

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.GraphDefinition.Nodes<State>
Type Parameters:
State - the type of state managed by the graph
Enclosing interface:
GraphDefinition<State extends AgentState>
public static class GraphDefinition.Nodes<State extends AgentState> extends Object
Container for nodes in a graph.

This class manages a collection of nodes and provides utility methods for querying and filtering nodes based on various criteria.
